title: Add VSCode Extension for Object UI
body:
## VSCode Extension Design for Object UI

Complete implementation of a production-ready VSCode extension for Object UI that provides a comprehensive development experience for schema-driven UI development.

### Features Implemented

#### Core Functionality
- **IntelliSense & Auto-completion**: Smart code completion for 14+ component types and context-aware property suggestions
- **Live Preview**: Side-by-side preview with Tailwind CSS integration and auto-refresh on save
- **Schema Validation**: Real-time validation with type-checking, accessibility warnings, and helpful error messages
- **Syntax Highlighting**: Custom TextMate grammar for Object UI JSON schemas
- **Code Snippets**: 12+ snippets for rapid development (forms, cards, layouts, dashboards, etc.)

#### Developer Tools
- **Export to React**: One-click export to React components with proper imports
- **Template Creation**: Create new schemas from 6 built-in templates
- **Format Command**: Auto-format JSON with configurable indentation
- **File Associations**: Support for `.objectui.json`, `.oui.json`, and `app.json` files

### Implementation Details

- **Extension Entry**: `src/extension.ts` - Activation and command registration
- **Language Providers**:
  - `CompletionProvider.ts` - Context-aware IntelliSense
  - `HoverProvider.ts` - Documentation on hover with Markdown formatting
  - `SchemaValidator.ts` - Real-time schema validation with diagnostics
  - `PreviewProvider.ts` - Webview-based live preview
- **Build Configuration**: TypeScript with strict mode, tsup bundler, ~32KB output
- **JSON Schema**: Complete schema definition for validation and IntelliSense

### Documentation

- **README.md**: User guide with features, installation, and usage instructions
- **DESIGN.md**: Architecture documentation with development guide and bilingual (EN/CN) explanations
- **PUBLISHING.md**: Complete guide for publishing to VSCode Marketplace with CI/CD examples
- **SUMMARY.md**: Implementation overview and technical summary
- **CHANGELOG.md**: Version history and release notes

### Quality Assurance

- ✅ Build tested successfully (~32KB bundle size)
- ✅ Code review completed - all issues addressed (deprecated APIs fixed, error handling improved)
- ✅ Security scan passed (CodeQL: 0 vulnerabilities)
- ✅ TypeScript strict mode enabled
- ✅ All features tested and functional

### Project Updates

- Updated main repository README to include the VSCode extension in the packages table
- Added extension icon (SVG format with gradient design)
- Configured proper .gitignore and .vscodeignore for distribution

The extension is production-ready and can be published to the VSCode Marketplace immediately.
